Before we get started

How much does a website cost?

Each project is quoted according to its pages, features and complexity. Send a short brief and I’ll help define a realistic scope before quoting.

How long does a project take?

The timeline depends on the agreed scope and how quickly content and feedback are provided. The schedule is confirmed before work starts.

Will my website work on phones?

Yes. Responsive layout is part of the design process, with attention to phone, tablet and desktop screens.

Can you redesign an existing website?

Yes. Include the current website link and the main things you want to improve in your enquiry.

Can customers pay online through my website?

Online payments need a suitable payment provider, secure back-end setup and testing. This is not automatically included in a standard front-end website and must be agreed separately.

How do we agree on payment?

Project scope, payment stages and delivery terms should be agreed in writing before work begins. Never send card details or passwords through this form.
